name: crr-cql-tooling
description: Translate CRR criteria CQL to ELM (@cqframework/cql, pure JS) and run scenario tests (cql-execution).

scripts.build: node translate.mjs libraries/FHIRHelpers-4.0.1.cql ../elm/FHIRHelpers-4.0.1.json && node translate.mjs ../cql/CRR_CTChestAbdomenPelvis_Adult.cql ../elm/CRR_CTChestAbdomenPelvis_Adult.json && node translate.mjs ../cql/CRR_CTCAP_Population.cql ../elm/CRR_CTCAP_Population.json && node translate.mjs ../cql/CRR_RedFlags.cql ../elm/CRR_RedFlags.json
scripts.test: node run-tests.mjs && node run-tests-redflags.mjs && node test-cross-bundle-include.mjs
